title: [finding] Console UX findings from a full app walkthrough (17.1.0): home todo mislabel, override prominence, feed noise, date/axis inconsistency, rating rendering
body:
[finding] Console UX findings from a full app walkthrough (17.1.0)

Collected while driving HotCRM end-to-end in a zh-CN session (`objectstack dev`, open edition). These are console-level behaviours, not app metadata — the app author cannot fix any of them. Each is independently actionable; split freely. Sharp single-topic defects from the same walkthrough are already filed (#10278, #10280, #10283, #10285, #10287, #10292, #10297, #10298); this card is the residue that is polish rather than defect.

## 1. The home page says "全部处理完毕" while the app holds 19 open tasks

Console home renders `待办事项 / 全部处理完毕` for a user whose CRM task list has 19 open rows, 9 of them 紧急 · due tomorrow. The widget reads only the platform inbox/approvals, but its label claims to be *the* todo list. Either scope the label ("平台通知") or give apps a way to feed it (e.g. a declared "my work" view per app).

## 2. Admin override is the most prominent action row on a locked record

For an admin, a record with a pending approval renders `越权通过 / 越权拒绝 / 越权转签 / 撤回` as the topmost action row — above the record's own actions, styled as primary. The override *dialog* is excellent (it explains seat-less override and attribution in plain language), but the placement trains admins to treat the exception as the default path. Secondary styling or a "管理员…" overflow menu fits the semantics.

## 3. A fresh record's feed opens with two system entries

Every create immediately shows `Created X` + `Updated X` (the second from a same-transaction flow write). Meaningful entries — `Stage: Prospecting → Needs Analysis`, approval decisions — drown between them on active records. Collapse create-plus-immediate-update into one entry, and consider defaulting the feed filter to human/business activity with 系统 as an opt-in.

## 4. Four date renderings coexist in one view

Adjacent surfaces mix `明天` / `8月5日` / `2026/8/21上午7:00` / `2026/8/20 22:01:24`. Relative-recent is good; the inconsistency is the problem. One policy (relative ≤7d, drop current year, full timestamp on hover) applied by the renderer would fix every app at once.

## 5. Chart axis units differ per dashboard in the same locale

One dashboard's revenue axis renders `20万 / 40万 / 60万`, another's renders `200,000 / 400,000` — same org, same locale, same currency-shaped measure. The unit rule should come from the locale + magnitude, not from which widget config happened to set it.

## 6. `rating` fields render as bare digits

Since the 9.11 removal of rating display props (`allowHalf` etc.) there is no replacement rendering: a lead list's 线索评分 column is `1 3 5 2 4` — unscannable. The type knows its own max; stars (or dots) in list cells is the whole ask.

## 7. Breadcrumb/tab truncation is aggressive

`Wei Zhang - Skybro…` at a width where `Wei Zhang - Skyline Media` would fit. Truncate the middle, keep the discriminating tail, full name on hover.

## 8. The dev-instance login banner could fill the form

The banner prints `admin@objectos.ai / admin123` as text; every evaluator's first act is to retype it. Click-to-fill on the banner removes the first friction of every demo.
